claims: "Golden" from KPop Demon Hunters won Best Original Song at the 98th Academy Awards on March 15, 2026.
"Golden" is the first K-pop song to win Best Original Song.
HUNTR/X performed "Golden" in the film KPop Demon Hunters.
HUNTR/X consists of Rei Ami, EJAE, Audrey Nuna.
"Golden" was written by a seven-person team.
Mark Sonnenblick is part of the writing team for "Golden".
Teddy Park is part of the writing team for "Golden".
Ejae is part of the writing team for "Golden".
The acceptance speech for "Golden" was cut short.
The cut-short acceptance speech for "Golden" sparked backlash from fans.
"Dear Me" from Relentless was nominated for Best Original Song at the 98th Academy Awards.
Diane Warren wrote "Dear Me" from Relentless.
"I Lied to You" from Sinners was nominated for Best Original Song at the 98th Academy Awards.
"Sweet Dreams of Joy" from Viva Verdi! was nominated for Best Original Song at the 98th Academy Awards.
"Train Dreams" from Train Dreams was nominated for Best Original Song at the 98th Academy Awards.
